messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(12 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Comment-only change, and it does clear the three kernel-doc warnings this file used to have. Several of the new descriptions don't match what the code does though, and four of the new Return sections are written without the colon kernel-doc requires. Running contrib/scripts/kernel-doc -Wall -none lustre/obdclass/llog_cat.c on the patched file reports four "No description found for return value" warnings; the parent revision had none of that kind. See inline.

commit.message:
LU-9633 obdclass: Add kernel doc style for obdclass (11)

This patch converts existing functional comments
to kernel doc style comments and removes '/**' for
comments which is not meant to be a kernel-doc comment

Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Arshad Hussain <arshad.hussain@aeoncomputing.com>
